pull_request.body: Reviewers write checklists like `- @pullbeacon review`. Strip a leading list marker before matching commands.
pull_request.title: Accept commands written as list items

ground_truth.rationale: Changing lstrip().startswith('>') to startswith('>') means a quoted command indented by spaces (e.g. '  > @pullbeacon apply' when replying to someone) is executed, contradicting the module contract that quoted commands never trigger.
